name: Pyromancer Grace of Alexstrasza dispels root and snare and grants immunity (#470)
contract: #470: Grace of Alexstrasza 802167 (RecoveryTime 300000 ms) has SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL_MECHANIC on mechanic 7 (root) and 11 (snare) at TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID radius 20 yd, plus a trigger of 803411, whose three aura 77 MECHANIC_IMMUNITY effects (root, snare, stun) last 4000 ms on the caster's allies. Spell::EffectDispelMechanic and Spell::EffectTriggerSpell are stock, no module code. The scenario groups two Pyromancers, roots (Entangling Roots 339, mechanic 7) and slows (Frostbolt 116) the ally through set_aura, casts 802167, and asserts both are removed, 803411 appears for about 4 s, the ally is immune to both spells, and the caster's cooldown starts. Stun immunity is not asserted (no verified stun spell). Values from inv-group-8.md and Spell.dbc. Frostbolt 116 has mechanic 11 only on effect 0 (aura 33), not on the spell as a whole, so its immunity is queried with spell_effect_immune effect 0; the first run's spell_immune returned 0 for it while root 339 (spell-level mechanic 7) returned 1.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Root the ally (Entangling Roots, mechanic root)
Slow the ally (Frostbolt chill, mechanic snare)
Ally is not yet immune to root
Ally is not yet immune to snare
The root is dispelled from the ally
The snare is dispelled from the ally
The ally receives the 4 s immunity aura 803411
The ally is now immune to root
The ally is now immune to snare
